name: trilly_pregrad_v3.2
supersedes: trilly_pregrad_v3.1 (selection unchanged since v2; v3.2 is the FIRST selection upgrade since v2)
what_changed: SELECTION. v3.1 ranked by ONE LGBM on label tr30_t1800_25. v3.2 ranks by a SEED-BAGGED (5 seeds) RANK-AVERAGE BLEND of THREE LGBM regressors on the SAME 20 pre-grad features, three labels: tr30_t1800_25 (trailing-exit PnL), oracle_25 (perfect-exit ceiling / 'oracle margin'), log1p(cumbv_peak) ('liquidity absorption' = cumulative buy USD up to the honest peak). Exit + entry + features + size UNCHANGED from v3.1.
entry: graduation instant; non-leaky fillability gate (fill<=grad+30s, slip<=15%)
selection_recipe: for each of 3 labels: average 5 seed boosters' predictions; percentile-rank that label-score across the candidate pool; blend = mean of the 3 percentile-ranks; pick the top-K/day by blend.

labels.liq: log1p(cumbv_peak)  [cumbv_peak = cumulative BUY USD up to the honest oracle-peak candidate]

boosters: boosters/<label>_s<seed>.txt  (3 labels x 5 seeds = 15 LightGBM models, full-population fit)
exit_policy: UNCHANGED from v3.1: tp12tr15_t1200 + holder force (arm 15% trailing after +12%, else 1200s timer; force-exit if pre-grad holder cohort sold>=40% AND price<=85% of running max). NO ratio trigger.

vs_v31_seed_bagged_30_per_day.honest_bootstrap_indep_cohorts: mean +$0.76/tr 95%CI[-0.62,+2.13] P(>0)=86% => NOT significant (directional only). MEDIAN +3.2pp 95%CI[+0.5,+5.8] P(>0)=99% => significant at 30/day (but does NOT survive Bonferroni over the ~25 variants explored).
vs_v31_seed_bagged_30_per_day.NOTE_biased_bootstrap_retracted: An earlier paired bootstrap (v32_sig.py::boot) re-selected a FIXED absolute top-K on with-replacement resamples (~2029 unique tokens fill top-3210) which shrank CIs ~2x and overstated significance (had reported mean P=96.8%, median P=100%). The honest design (v32_sig_honest.py, independent resample of the two frozen cohorts) is the corrected truth above.

honest_significance: The DEFENSIBLE win is SELECTION QUALITY / cohort cleanliness: the blend's picked-cohort median rises +3.5%->+6.9% and win-rate 53%->57%, significant at 30/day (honest indep-cohort bootstrap median diff +3.2pp 95%CI[+0.5,+5.8]) and consistent across all 5 seeds and K=2140-5350. The MEAN $/day lift (+$23/day central) is DIRECTIONAL ONLY -- not statistically significant (P=86%, CI crosses 0) and it INVERTS at shallow K (at 10/day the blend is -$1.33/tr WORSE than v3.1). The median lift also does not survive Bonferroni over the ~25 selection variants explored, so even it is a LEAD not a proof. Bottom line: v3.2 is a marginal-but-consistent cleaner-cohort candidate on the live-faithful (non-momentum) axis; expected live edge is breakeven-to-slightly-positive. The soak is the only arbiter.
caveats: MEAN/$ lift NOT significant under honest bootstrap (P=86%, CI[-0.62,+2.13]); report as directional only.
Depth-fragile: blend is WORSE than v3.1 at ~10/day (-$1.33/tr). Edge is specific to 30-50/day. Median lift is more depth-stable.
Multiple comparisons: blend is the post-hoc best of ~25 variants; median p~0.02-0.03 does NOT survive Bonferroni. The soak is the real out-of-sample test.
74% cohort overlap with v3.1 (2367/3210) -- the edge is reshuffling the marginal ~26% of picks; genuinely modest.
Soak HEAD-TO-HEAD with v3.1 (same 20 features, same exit, $25; only the score differs).
provenance: OOT 5-fold chrono walk-forward on ~23.9k enterable graduated tokens (2026-02-27..06-13), honest-fill per-swap tapes (FEE 1%, fill>=grad+2s slip<=15%, depth-aware drain-VWAP exit, dust-guard + oracle_25<=2000). ALL features from the pre-grad curve tape [<grad] => leak-safe at entry=graduation; the three labels are post-grad OUTCOMES used only as training targets. ex_deploy eval is bit-exact vs the established v3.1 column. Repro: analysis/graduated/v32_precompute.py -> v32_select.py -> v32_ensemble.py -> v32_robust.py -> v32_sig.py -> v32_build.py.
